name: Glide for Brainrots
desc:
Welcome to Glide For Brainrots! 🪂🌊

🪂 Grab Brainrots and glide back to safety!
🌊 Don’t let the Lava Tsunami catch you mid-flight!
⚡ Use boosts to go farther + escape faster!
💸 Upgrade your Brainrots to earn way more money!
🏗️ Upgrade your base for more slots to store Brainrots!
